This repository uses Python package/slash-command architecture in v4.1.9. `.claude-plugin/` and the TypeScript plugin system DO NOT EXIST; planned for v5.0 (issue #419, `docs/plugin-reorg.md`, `docs/next-refactor-plan.md`). `plugins/superclaude/` is future source, NOT ACTIVE.

**Python rule:** This project uses **UV** for all Python operations. Never use `python -m`, `pip install`, or `python script.py` directly.

```sh
uv run pytest
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/
uv pip install package
uv run python script.py
make dev              # Install editable with dev dependencies
make verify           # Verify installation (package, plugin, health)
make test             # Full test suite
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/ -v
uv run pytest tests/test_file.py -v
uv run pytest -m confidence_check
uv run pytest --cov=superclaude
make lint             # ruff
make format           # ruff
make doctor
make build-plugin            # Build plugin artefacts into dist/
make sync-plugin-repo        # Sync artefacts into ../SuperClaude_Plugin
make clean
```

**Architecture:** `pyproject.toml` entry point auto-loads pytest plugin after installation. Package `superclaude` (hatchling/PEP 517); CLI `superclaude`; pytest plugin auto-loaded as `superclaude`.
- `src/superclaude/`: `pytest_plugin.py`; `pm_agent/{confidence.py,self_check.py,reflexion.py}`; `execution/{parallel.py,reflection.py,self_correction.py}`; `cli/{main.py,doctor.py,install_skill.py}`.
- `commands/`: slash commands installed by `superclaude install`; `settings.json`, `index-repo.md`. Available: `/pm`, `/research`, `/index-repo` and others; installed to `~/.claude/commands/`. Install: `pipx install superclaude && superclaude install`.
- `tests/`: Python suite; `scripts/`: workflow metrics/A-B tools. `PLANNING.md`: architecture/absolute rules; `TASK.md`: tasks; `KNOWLEDGE.md`: insights. More docs: `docs/user-guide/`, `docs/developer-guide/`, `docs/reference/`.

**PM tools:** ConfidenceChecker (`confidence.py`): pre-execution, ≥90% proceed, 70–89% alternatives, <70% questions. SelfCheckProtocol (`self_check.py`): evidence-based post-implementation validation; verify tests/docs, no speculation. ReflexionPattern (`reflexion.py`): error learning and cross-session pattern matching. Fixtures: `confidence_checker`, `self_check_protocol`, `reflexion_pattern`, `token_budget`, `pm_context`. Markers: `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.unit`, `.mark.integration`, `.mark.confidence_check`, `.mark.self_check`, `.mark.reflexion`; complexity: `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.complexity("medium")` (simple 200, medium 1000, complex 2500).

**Execution:** Use Wave → Checkpoint → Wave (3.5x faster): parallel reads → analyze → parallel edits; automatic dependency analysis. Token budgets: simple 200, medium 1,000, complex 2,500. Confidence check ROI: spend 100–200 to save 5,000–50,000.

**Branches:** `master` (production) ← `integration` (testing) ← `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`.
1. `git checkout -b feature/your-feature` from `integration`
2. Develop/tests: `uv run pytest`
3. `git commit -m "feat: description"` (conventional commits)
4. Merge to `integration`, validate, then `master`.
Current branch: session-start git status.
**CRITICAL**: When running multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, use `git worktree` to avoid conflicts.
```sh
cd ~/github/SuperClaude_Framework
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration integration
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-feature feature/pm-agent
git worktree remove ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration
```
Use separate sessions/directories: `~/github/SuperClaude_Framework/`, `~/github/SuperClaude_Framework-integration/`, `~/github/SuperClaude_Framework-feature/`.

**Research:** **Never guess** - verify with official docs (Context7 MCP, WebFetch, WebSearch) before implementation. Always prefer MCP tools over speculation for documentation/research. Via airis-mcp-gateway: Tavily (web/deep research), Context7 (official docs), Sequential (reasoning, 30–50% token reduction), Serena (session persistence), Mindbase (cross-session learning); optional Playwright, Magic, Chrome DevTools. TypeScript plugins and Python pytest plugin can call MCP servers.

Setup:
```sh
pipx install superclaude
git clone https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework.git
cd SuperClaude_Framework
```
